rules.rule: Long-running forge operations (CI runs, merge checks) are watched BY the agent — background loop or watcher — never framed back to the human as "should I keep monitoring?". The human hears outcomes.
State queries (ci-status, mr-status) must hit the provider's API directly. Provider CLIs that serve cached listings are bound through their cache-free forms; a stale answer is worse than a slow one.
A push is not done at exit 0: after every push, query ci-status and carry the result into the evidence. A push with a failing pipeline is not "done" (constitution §verify-never-claim).
Credentials and token plumbing live in the binding (or the provider's credential helper), never improvised per-session. If auth fails, fix the binding — do not inline secrets into commands or files.

verb.intent: Push the current branch to the canonical remote, with whatever auth the provider needs.
Latest pipeline/workflow state for this repo — result, status, branch. Cache-free.
Queue the repo's primary pipeline on a branch (extra args pass through).
Block-and-poll a run to a terminal state, emitting transitions; used by background watchers per rule poll-yourself.
Open a merge/pull request from the current branch to the default branch (title from args).
State of open MRs/PRs for this repo — id, title, vote/check state. Cache-free.
Print the repo's web URL (for handoffs and humans).
